genesis_invariants: RIGHTS-INV-001: a subject id is immutable after first registration; metadata may only revise through its controller or a scoped capability
RIGHTS-INV-002: a right claim can only reference an existing subject and an active governance-configured right class
RIGHTS-INV-003: ordinary rights claims are holder-originated or capability-scoped; governance is not a universal rights-holder backdoor
RIGHTS-INV-004: a license cannot outlive the underlying right claim and cannot be created against an ineffective right
RIGHTS-INV-005: only the right holder or a scoped capability may grant/revoke a revocable license; the licensee may renounce its own license
RIGHTS-INV-006: effective use requires the exact licensee and exact committed scope hash
RIGHTS-INV-007: on-chain claims commit jurisdiction and evidence but do not self-assert legal adjudicative finality
RIGHTS-INV-008: 420 Market may reference/list canonical license ids but has no authority to create or mutate 420Rights state
